statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116321 (PostgreSQL unterminated name value discloses server memory): changing the final byte of a fixed-length name value to a nonzero byte through array element assignment lets a database user disclose server memory when the value is used as a C string. It is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16 for major version 16. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116321/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/c673c0a6178ad3e6ff16f4900fcfcf0dd927ba36, which carries the trailers "Security: CVE-2026-116321" and "Backpatch-through: 14", is contained in the REL_16_16 tag and not in REL_16_15, and changes only src/backend/utils/adt/arrayfuncs.c, so that element assignment can no longer change the last byte of a fixed-length name value, which must stay zero, and rejects an assignment that leaves the name invalidly encoded. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116321 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql16 16.16-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 16.16 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql16 at 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0; we downloaded the packages named below for every one of those builds on both architectures, each checked against its index checksum. The vulnerable code is in the server, usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, which the postgresql16 package ships in every published build on both architectures. In the 16.16-r0 build the postgres server binary, usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, reports PostgreSQL 16.16 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) it reports that older 16.x release on both architectures. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 16.16, so they are affected; 16.16-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116321, improper null termination in array element assignment of name values, which discloses server memory, in 17.12 (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116321/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116321, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/). Earlier 17 releases are affected. The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
